errors.text: The intervention is not uniquely specified: it proposes V, Cr, or Hf/Zr-ratio tuning rather than the targeted 4.2 at.% Cr addition.
The predicted density trend is reversed. Adding low-density Cr to this Hf-Ta-rich alloy should reduce, not marginally increase, density.

The proposed baseline-versus-alloy experiment does not cleanly distinguish solid-solution hardening from the Laves-network mechanism because solute content and secondary-phase formation change simultaneously.
